name: YMCA Camp Boroughs
operator_name: YMCA of Central Massachusetts (Boroughs Family Branch YMCA)
description_short: Outdoor YMCA day camp in Westborough for ages 3 to 12, with leadership and counselor in training programs for older kids. Campers swim, play sports, do crafts, STEM and archery (age 7 and up), and children 7 to 12 can add optional weekly field trips.
refund_policy_summary: The $50 weekly deposit is non refundable; other payments are refunded with two weeks' notice. No refunds for behavior suspensions, illness, weather closures or days a family keeps the child home.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 prices (non member, members in brackets): ages 3 to 6 $460 per week ($360); ages 7 to 10 $390 ($290); Leader in Training ages 11 to 12 $390 ($290); Counselor in Training ages 13 to 14 $315 per two weeks ($215). Camp 7:45 am to 5:30 pm. age_max 14 covers the CIT program; the core camp is ages 3 to 12. Lunch packed from home or bought separately from the Fitbar. 2026 themes list eleven weeks, Week 1 June 15 to 18 (closed June 19). Field trips for ages 7 to 12 cost $50 to $75 each.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 parent handbook: Boroughs Family Branch YMCA, 4 Valente Drive, Westborough, MA 01581; camp director Larry Harding, lharding@ymcaofcm.org; the YMCA offers financial assistance to qualifying families; $50 non refundable deposit per week; two weeks' notice for refunds.

source.title: Camp Boroughs - YMCA of Central Massachusetts

warnings: Not a duplicate: the existing YMCA of Central Massachusetts multi branch overview draft (status drop) only mentions Boroughs; this is the branch's own camp listing.
The 2026 brochure lists ten weeks and the camp page eleven (it adds a Season Finale week August 24 to 28); the page's eleven weeks are used.
Before and after care are built into the 7:45 am to 5:30 pm day, so extended_care is left empty.
No 2027 information yet; this is the 2026 season.
